The new Derange is nice... but one thing is a bit unclear. The card
says "This card cannot be played on a Malkavian or Malkavian
Antitribu". Does moving the card (as a (D) action) count as
"playing", and can the card be moved (back) to a Malkavian or
!Malkavian?

The old Derange had a ruling that it could not be moved to a
!Malkavian. How about this one?

//Petri
